SAPUI5 TypeScript API (1.120.51) / sap.viz / sap/viz/ui5/api/env/Format / Format

Interface: Format

import Format from "sap/viz/ui5/api/env/Format";

Provides methods set global formatter for VizFrame.

Since

1.24.0

Methods

numericFormatter()

numericFormatter(formatter): any

Customize the global numeric formatter. If you set a formatter, it will replace the existing formatter. This function will take effect globally.

Example:


// Format required from "sap/viz/ui5/api/env/Format"
var customerFormatter = {
    format : function(value, pattern) {
        // add your codes here to convert number value to formatted string
        // according to the pattern string
        return formattedString;
    }
};
Format.numericFormatter(customerFormatter);

Parameters

formatter

Function

Returns

any
